text:
alice: OK team — scheduling the APAC edge routing swap for tonight 02:30 UTC. Goal: switch traffic from policy v1 -> v2 with canary then ramp. Lowering DNS TTL to 30s at T-10m.

ben: I can run the swap. I’ll be on standby 02:15-03:00 UTC.

clara: Quick checklist? smoke checks, rollback plan? :)

alice: smoke checks: synthetic health ping (200), sample chat latency < 200ms p50, KV cache hit % not dropping >5pts, and per-route error rate <0.5%. If anything fails we rollback to v1 and restore previous DNS TTL.

ben: noted. I’ll execute canary -> 5% for 10m, then 25% for 5m, then 100% if green. Manual hold between stages.

dave-sre: DNS provider (FastRoute) confirmed TTL change possible via API. I’ll run the TTL update at T-10m and revert at T+30m if rollback. I’ll also watch for propagation issues.

enrico: I’ll have dashboards up: per-region latency, error rates, KV hit rate, and token cost. I’ll post a single-line green/yellow/red every 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: RDW-1192. Canary plan attached. Ops runbook: https://confluence/internal/rdw/apac-edge-swap

clara: rollback readiness? who hits rollback and what’s the command?

ben: I will perform rollback. Command is: 
```
redwoodctl route set-policy --edge apac --policy v1 --force
redwoodctl dns set-ttl --zone apac.edge.redwood.ai --ttl 300
```
Do not run DNS revert until we confirm route rollback in runtime logs.

dave-sre: Agreed. I’ll only touch DNS after ben confirms runtime rollback. I’ll keep DNS API keys at hand.

alice: Communication plan: post status in #eng-platform and ping @oncall if any regressions. I’ll be in the channel until +30m after full swap.

ben: timeline: T-10m lower TTL -> T (02:30) start canary 5% -> T+10m ramp to 25% -> T+15m gate -> T+20m 100% if green -> T+30m restore TTL to 300s.

enrico: One more: please capture a small sample of request IDs for reruns if we see quality drift. I’ll add a quick log filter: 
```
index=prod source=apac-edge | stats count by route, status | where status!=200
```

clara: tagging the docs owner @alice and @dave-sre so postmortem link is created if needed.

ben: I’ll announce start 5m before. Anyone want to be primary verifier for smoke checks?

enrico: I’ll be primary for metrics, dave-sre for infra, clara for functional tests.

alice: perfect. thanks all — see you at 02:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
